title: Möbius coefficients
statement: For a real-valued function $\varphi$ on binary vectors of length $n$, define its Möbius coefficient at a coordinate subset $S$ by $\displaystyle\sum_{T\subseteq S}(-1)^{|S|-|T|}\varphi(1_T)$, where $1_T$ is the binary vector whose coordinates in $T$ equal $1$ and whose other coordinates equal $0$.
hypotheses_covered: A real-valued function on binary vectors of length $n
